==Hero Usage==
* Heroes will maintain this spell both in and out of combat.

== Notes ==
* The amount of energy regained is rounded; for example, a 5 energy  spell returns 3 energy instead of 2.5 energy, and a 15 energy spell returns 6 energy instead of 5.5 energy.
